START HERE · Wf-07 • Monarch Ai Agent
Yeh folder studio ka saara AI-generated video kaam rakhta hai. Generate karne wala engine hamara apna hai: VIPER-1 (tools/videogen.py), aur uske peeche ka knowledge WF-06 (styles/minimax-h3-video/) me hai.
1. Free hai ya nahi?
Cheez
	Free?
	Note
	VIPER-1 tool
	✅ free
	repo me, koi subscription nahi
	Free route: Colab T4 + Wan 2.1 1.3B + LatentSync + ffmpeg
	✅ $0
	480×832 silent base, 10–25 min/clip
	Free upscale: Real-ESRGAN ×2 (T4) ya Lanczos ×2 (CPU)
	✅ $0
	480p → 960×1664 — sharper, naya detail nahi
	MiniMax-H3 API (2K, native stereo, dialogue one pass)
	❌ paid
	$0.08/s @768P · $0.13/s @2K
	Drive (yeh folder)
	✅ free 15 GB
	masters bhaari hote hain — purane runs archive karo
	

480p ka jawab: free route 480×832 deta hai; upscale usko 960×1664 karta hai (free). Asli 1080p/2K + native dialogue sirf paid H3 se. Ladder: styles/monarch-ai-agent/knowledge/QUALITY.md.


Matlab: tool free, draft/plates free, sirf hero shots ka paisa — aur woh bhi sirf jab aap khud render --yes chalao, estimate dekhne ke baad. API key na ho to har shot free chain par chalta hai.
2. Folder map
Folder
	Kya
	01 · START HERE
	yeh guide
	02 · Engine (VIPER-1)
	videogen.py + VIDEOGEN.md manual
	03 · Colab Notebooks
	free T4 notebook + H3 API notebook
	04 · Knowledge
	model facts, prompting, free routes, toolbox, tool registry
	05 · Projects
	per project: project.json, plan.json, receipts.json, shots/
	06 · Masters & Receipts
	final masters + md5 receipts
	3. Ek click flow (free)
1. Colab → 03 · Colab Notebooks/MONARCH_T4_FREE_BRIDGE.ipynb upload karo
2. Runtime → T4 GPU → cells 1–7 Run
3. Clips Drive me 05 · Projects/<project>/shots/ me aa jayenge
4. Lipsync: lipsync/<shot>.sh (LatentSync 1.5 + T4 fp16 patch) — apni awaaz ke saath
4. Command flow (repo)
python3 tools/videogen.py doctor


python3 tools/videogen.py new --id <project-id> --title "<title>" --aspect 9:16


python3 tools/videogen.py plan   <project>/project.json


python3 tools/videogen.py render <project>/project.json          # dry run — $0


python3 tools/videogen.py render <project>/project.json --yes    # paid only


python3 tools/videogen.py upscale <project>/project.json          # 480p -> 960p notebook


python3 tools/videogen.py verify <project>/project.json          # exit 3 = deliver nahi hua


python3 tools/videogen.py assemble <project>/project.json
5. Rules
1. Estimate pehle, paisa baad me (budget_usd hard gate, 1.5× retries).
2. verify pass hone se pehle koi delivery claim nahi.
3. Free = draft/animatic; paid = hero 2K.
4. 2K sirf API route se.
5. Har master ke saath md5 receipt.
6. Finish (typography/music/conform) WF-05 me.


Full detail: repo styles/monarch-ai-agent/README.md + docs/VIDEOGEN.md.
